title: Quantum Harish–Chandra isomorphism over C(q,t) between the quantized multiplicative Jordan-quiver variety and the spherical GLn double affine Hecke algebra
source_title: Quantum Harish-Chandra isomorphism for the double affine Hecke algebra of GL$_n$
author: Joshua Jeishing Wen
difficulty_reason: The published ribbon-category, Macdonald and PBW prerequisites do not themselves construct the generic radial-parts action because the required Verma modules have no coevaluation. The author supplies new admissible-diagram and restricted-action constructions, verifies the full quantum moment reduction, and proves Pieri preservation and compatibility at infinitely many integral specializations. The remaining generic isomorphism then uses the fully retained local invariant/classical-degeneration dimension and finite-generation/localization arguments, rather than being a formal relabeling of the finite-dimensional theorem.

proof_review.note: Full article retained as conservative closed context for notation, global assumptions, diagrams and references. Exact primary and supporting physical proof pages are recorded separately. Theorem5.20/Main Theorem over the rational function field K=C(q,t), with the exact Jordan quiver and one-dimensional framing data1.2 and quantum Hamiltonian reduction defined in4.14/5.3.4. The radial parts map identifies A_alpha with the faithful polynomial-representation image of spherical GLn DAHA; no numerical specialization at arbitrary q,t or other reductive/quiver types claimed. Full local quantum-trace/invariant/classical degeneration34–39 and generic Verma-action/moment reduction/Pieri preservation/specialization proof39–47 read. New diagrams on41–45 and supporting30–31/33/36 visually inspected in unchanged PDF; exact braid-product/partial-adjoint/action maps retained. The author leaves5.21 as a drawing exercise; this is the bounded ancillary associativity check for the explicitly drawn product5.18 and action5.20 by named Reshetikhin–Turaev ribbon isotopy3.4, not an omitted new algebra/action construction or assistant repair. Remark5.15 leaves an action on the entire tHom space unproved; the selected theorem only uses the explicitly constructed restricted tHom_D/Int action of Lemma5.14, whose proof is included. Named published Cherednik faithful polynomial representation, Etingof–Kirillov intertwiner/Macdonald theory, Jordan PBW/moment maps, Gan–Ginzburg almost commuting invariants and BGG tensor-Verma decomposition are traced in the preserved context. The generic proof uses arbitrarily large integral k, within the common k>2n range supplied by generator Lemma2.5; the separate stronger printed all-k>n specialization statement is not counted. Appendix modular-transformation outcome remains unreviewed and unselected. Whole53-page original retained with actual2026volume13 DOI10.5802/jep.326 and pinned acquisition dates.
